हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Operation Chinar is a Kashmir set spy thriller about ATS officer Rudra Kaul, who returns home undercover during a college reunion to expose powerful politician Rafiq Mir’s terror network. As he digs deeper, Rudra is torn between a long-buried love, Meera, her fearless daughter Zara, and a conspiracy that reaches the highest ranks of the system,where every ally could be a traitor and every emotion a potential weapon.
